name: MiniMax H3
role: People speaking to camera with lip sync (German and other languages), objects that must match a reference photo

pricing.note: Reference images are billed on top; the estimate counts every reference, so it is an upper bound.

gotchas: A reference written as {"image_url": ...} without "type": "image_url" is rejected with 400 "No matching discriminator".
frame_images wins over input_references: with a first frame, the references are ignored.
It delivers about 0.6 s more than requested and keeps talking to the end. End the dialogue with a short filler line and cut on it in the edit.
It invents lettering on any cover, screen or sign it is told about. Keep surfaces turned away or plain, add real text in the edit.
Same first frame + same scene text + only the dialogue changing = the same person and room across takes.
No seed: two identical calls give two different takes.
